versions.content: When responding to UDS Service 0x19 with subfunction 0x18, the Dcm module shall obtain the status of the DTC by first calling Dem_GetStatusOfDTC() with the following parameters: • ClientId: Client Id for this Dcm instance (see DcmDemClientRef • DTC : DTC from the request • DTCOrigin: Memory Selection from request + 0x0100 and then Dem_GetStatusOfDTC() with ClientId = DcmDemClientRef
